verdict.rationale: The Virginia State Corporation Commission is a government regulatory body with a business-filing system, not an AI agent or host application. Acting as an MCP client that plugs in external MCP servers is outside its product category. The evidence pack holds only robots.txt probes and shows no MCP client capability, so the axis does not apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
